description: Equipements municipaux de la ville de Saint-Maur-des-Fossés is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Saint-Maur des Fossés. Map data of the municipal facilities of the City of Saint-Maur-des-Fossés. Coverage: Saint-Maur des Fossés. The portal shows the English title as "Municipal equipment of the city of Saint-Maur-des-Fossés" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Saint-Maur des Fossés. The listing shows 2 download or service links in KML, CSV. The listing shows 2016-04-11 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
